**Job Title: Sales Engineer**

Job Summary

The Engineering Sales Manager is responsible for driving sales of technical or engineering products and solutions by combining strong engineering knowledge with sales and business development skills. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, managing key client relationships, supporting the sales team with technical expertise, and achieving revenue targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Sales & Business Development

Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and growth targets.

Identify and pursue new business opportunities in target industries.

Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals.

Prepare and deliver technical presentations and product demonstrations to customers.

2. Client Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, and contractors.

Understand customer requirements and propose appropriate technical solutions.

Negotiate pricing, contracts, and commercial terms.

3. Technical Support & Solution Selling

Provide technical consultation to customers regarding engineering products or services.

Work closely with engineering, design, and production teams to develop customized solutions.

Prepare technical proposals, quotations, and tender documents.

4. Team Management

Lead and mentor the sales engineering team.

Set sales targets and monitor team performance.

Provide training on technical products and sales techniques.

5. Market & Competitor Analysis

Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging technologies.

Provide insights to management for product improvements and new opportunities.

6. Reporting & Coordination

Prepare sales forecasts, reports, and pipeline updates.

Coordinate with internal departments such as engineering, production, and finance.

Ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction.

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Industrial / Engineering or related field.

MBA in Marketing or Sales (preferred but not always mandatory).

**Experience**

2–5 years of experience in engineering or technical sales.

Experience in B2B industrial sales preferred.

**Key Skills**

Technical product knowledge

B2B sales and negotiation

Client relationship management

Team leadership

Proposal and tender preparation

CRM and sales pipeline management

Communication and presentation skills

title: Logistics Executive
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat (on-site)  
**Experience:** 1 to 3 years in import/export logistics  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Logistics Executive (EXIM) to manage import and export shipments end to end. You will coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shippers and consignees to ensure shipments move on time, within budget and in full compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and coordinate import and export shipments by sea and air.
* Get freight quotes from multiple forwarders and compare rates and transit times.
* Prepare and verify shipping documents: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading/airway bill, certificate of origin, shipping bill and bill of entry.
* Coordinate with CHAs and customs authorities for timely clearance.
* Book containers and cargo space, and track shipments until delivery.
* Monitor demurrage, detention and storage charges, and take steps to avoid them.
* Handle freight invoices and verify them against agreed rates.
* Maintain shipment records, MIS reports and an updated tracking sheet.
* Coordinate with internal teams (purchase, sales, accounts, warehouse) on shipment status.
* Handle export incentives and documentation (RoDTEP, drawback) where applicable.

**Requirements**

* Graduate in any stream (B.Com, BBA or Supply Chain preferred).
* 1 to 3 years of experience in EXIM or freight forwarding operations.
* Working knowledge of Incoterms, HS codes and customs procedures.
* Good knowledge of shipping documents and DGFT/customs processes.
* Proficient in MS Excel and email communication.
* Strong follow-up, coordination and negotiation skills.
* Good communication in English and Hindi (Gujarati is a plus).

**Good to Have**

* Experience with ERP/SAP or logistics software.
* Exposure to LCL/FCL, air freight and project cargo.
* Knowledge of DG (dangerous goods) shipments.

**What We Offer**

* Salary: as per experience / 40000-50000₹ range
* Learning exposure to international trade and logistics operations
* Growth opportunities within the team

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

description:
Job Description – Finance & Operations Intern / Trainee

HTS – Happy Tongue and Soul Pvt. Ltd.

Freshers WelcomeFinance & Operations

1. About HTS – Happy Tongue and Soul Pvt. Ltd.

HTS is a fast-growing food services company offering corporate catering, industrial meal services, institutional dining, cafeteria management, event catering, and retail food solutions across Gujarat.

With a strong focus on quality, hygiene, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence, HTS currently serves 700+ meals daily and offers a diverse culinary portfolio of 500+ à la carte dishes.

Our operations include:

* Cloud Kitchen – Sanand: Serving industrial and corporate clients, including TATA and other reputed organizations.
* JS Hospital, Shivranjani, Ahmedabad: Hospital cafeteria operations.
* IIT Gandhinagar: Restaurant operations.

We are proud to serve and work with reputed organizations and institutions, including TATA Projects, TATA Agratas, Turner Construction, Mitsuba India, Townsend, IIT Gandhinagar, IIM Ahmedabad, and JS Hospital.

Our service portfolio includes corporate meals, industrial catering, event catering, cafeteria management, institutional dining, and retail food services.

Our Growth Vision: We aim to scale from 700+ meals daily to 7,000 meals per day within the next 2–3 years.

As we expand, we are strengthening our finance and operations functions and looking for enthusiastic young professionals who want hands-on exposure to managing and growing a food services business.

2. Position Details

Position - Finance & Operations Intern / Trainee

Department - Finance & Operations

Location - Ahmedabad / Sanand

Experience - Fresher – 1 year

Qualification - B.Com / M.Com / BBA / MBA Finance

Role Type - Individual Contributor

Reporting To - Finance & Operations Manager / Business Head

3. Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented, organised, and proactive Finance & Operations Intern / Trainee to support the day-to-day financial and operational activities of HTS.

The individual will get practical exposure to financial accounting, billing, vendor management, purchase coordination, inventory control, cost monitoring, MIS reporting, and operational tracking across our three business locations.

This role is ideal for a fresher who wants to understand how the finance and operations functions work together in a growing food services business.

The individual will work closely with the management and operations teams to ensure accurate financial records, timely reporting, cost control, and smooth day-to-day business operations.

4. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Finance & Accounting

* Assist in day-to-day accounting and financial record maintenance.
* Prepare and maintain sales invoices and purchase bills.
* Support customer billing and ensure invoices are raised accurately and on time.
* Maintain records of customer payments and outstanding receivables.
* Track vendor payments and pending bills.
* Assist in bank reconciliation and cash/bank transaction records.
* Maintain expense records and supporting documentation.
* Assist in GST-related documentation and coordination with the accounting team.
* Support monthly financial closing activities.

B. Billing & Revenue Tracking

* Maintain daily sales and billing records for all HTS outlets.
* Track client-wise and location-wise revenue.
* Verify meal quantities against client orders and actual supplies.
* Ensure accurate preparation of corporate catering bills.
* Maintain records of customer coupons, meal counts, and other billing-related information.
* Track outstanding payments and coordinate with the sales/operations teams for follow-ups.

C. Cost Control & Financial Analysis

* Track food costs, raw material expenses, packaging costs, and other operating expenses.
* Assist in monitoring food cost and consumption against business volumes.
* Maintain location-wise expense statements.
* Support preparation of monthly P&L statements and MIS reports.
* Identify unusual cost variations and highlight them to management.
* Assist in analysing profitability across different outlets and corporate accounts.
* Help monitor wastage and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.

D. Purchase & Vendor Management

* Maintain purchase records and vendor databases.
* Assist in collecting and comparing vendor quotations.
* Track purchase orders and ensure proper documentation.
* Verify material quantities received against purchase orders and invoices.
* Coordinate with kitchen and outlet teams for procurement requirements.
* Maintain vendor payment schedules and outstanding balances.
* Support periodic vendor price comparisons.

E. Inventory & Stock Management

* Maintain inventory records for raw materials, groceries, packaging, and other consumables.
* Assist in monitoring daily stock consumption.
* Coordinate periodic physical stock verification.
* Track stock shortages, excess inventory, and wastage.
* Ensure proper documentation of material inward and outward movements.
* Help establish systematic inventory tracking across all outlets.

F. Operations Coordination & Monitoring

* Coordinate with the teams at Sanand, JS Hospital, and IIT Gandhinagar.
* Collect daily operational data, including meal quantities, sales, purchases, and consumption.
* Monitor daily meal production and dispatch records against client requirements.
* Maintain operational trackers and reports.
* Assist in monitoring attendance, manpower deployment, and related records.
* Highlight operational gaps, discrepancies, and delays to management.
* Support implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs).

G. MIS & Management Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Maintain Excel-based trackers for revenue, expenses, purchases, inventory, and outstanding payments.
* Prepare outlet-wise and client-wise performance reports.
* Assist in creating dashboards for management review.
* Ensure accuracy and timely submission of reports.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Area - Expected Deliverables

Accounting - Accuracy and timely updating of financial records

Billing - Timely and accurate client billing

Receivables - Regular tracking of outstanding payments

Payables - Accurate vendor payment records

Inventory - Proper stock records and reconciliation

Cost Control - Regular tracking of food and operating costs

MIS - Timely and accurate reporting

Operations - Effective coordination across all outlets

Documentation - Proper maintenance of financial and operational records

6. Skills & Competencies Required

Educational Background

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA / MBA Finance.
* Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles.

Technical Skills

* Good working knowledge of MS Excel.
* Understanding of accounting software such as Tally is preferred.
* Knowledge of GST and basic accounting concepts is an advantage.
* Ability to work with spreadsheets, reports, and numerical data.

Personal Competencies

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical and numerical skills.
* Organised and systematic approach to work.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Ability to work with multiple teams and locations.
* Proactive approach to identifying discrepancies and solving problems.

7. What HTS Offers

* Hands-on exposure to finance and operations in a growing food services business.
* Opportunity to work directly with business leadership.
* Exposure to real-world accounting, costing, procurement, and business operations.
* Opportunity to understand outlet-level profitability and business performance.
* Practical learning in MIS, financial analysis, and cost management.
* Opportunity to take ownership of processes and contribute improvement ideas.
* Performance-based opportunity to grow into a full-time Finance & Operations Executive role.

8. Why Join HTS?

At HTS, you will get an opportunity to understand how a multi-location food services business operates financially and operationally.

You will not be restricted to routine data entry. You will learn how revenue is generated, how costs are managed, how inventory is controlled, how vendors are managed, and how management uses financial information to make business decisions.

As HTS expands towards its target of 7,000 meals daily, you will have the opportunity to grow along with the organisation.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹29,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

description:

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Management

- Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries.

- Maintain accurate books of accounts in accordance with applicable accounting principles.

- Manage general ledger, customer accounts, supplier accounts, and intercompany transactions.

- Perform regular bank, cash, customer, and supplier reconciliations.

- Maintain accounts receivable and payable records and prepare ageing reports.

- Monitor outstanding payments, collections, and accounting discrepancies.

2. GST Compliance & Indian Taxation

- Prepare and verify GST workings, including input tax credit (ITC), output GST, reverse charge mechanism (RCM), and applicable GST rates.

- Prepare and reconcile GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B, and purchase register data.

- Reconcile books of accounts with GST portal data and identify discrepancies in input tax credit.

- Monitor GST compliance for sales, purchases, credit notes, debit notes, and applicable e-commerce transactions.

- Assist with GST return filing, annual returns, and related reconciliations, including GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C wherever applicable.

- Ensure proper documentation and accounting treatment for intra-state and inter-state transactions, exports, and applicable zero-rated supplies.

- Handle TDS calculations, deductions, deposit tracking, and preparation and reconciliation of TDS returns.

- Assist with income tax computations, advance tax workings, and other applicable statutory tax compliances.

- Coordinate with tax consultants and auditors for assessments, notices, reconciliations, and statutory requirements.

3. Sales Billing & E-commerce Reconciliation

- Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices, credit notes, and debit notes in compliance with GST invoicing requirements.

- Reconcile e-commerce and marketplace sales with settlement reports, bank receipts, and books of accounts.

- Account for sales returns, refunds, marketplace commissions, payment gateway charges, and other deductions.

- Reconcile GST on marketplace transactions with relevant settlement statements and tax reports.

- Prepare monthly sales reconciliation and outstanding payment reports.

4. Final Accounts & Financial Reporting

- Independently prepare Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Account, and Balance Sheet.

- Prepare supporting schedules and perform year-end adjustments, including accruals, provisions, prepayments, and depreciation.

- Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.

- Ensure proper classification of expenses, assets, liabilities, revenue, and other financial transactions.

- Assist in the preparation of financial statements and audit schedules.

- Coordinate with internal and external auditors during statutory and financial audits.

5. MIS & Documentation

- Prepare monthly financial reports, expense summaries, and reconciliation statements.

- Maintain organised accounting records, invoices, tax documents, and supporting schedules.

- Identify and resolve discrepancies in accounting entries, GST data, and financial reports.

- Ensure compliance with internal financial controls and reporting deadlines.

**Requirements**

- Minimum 3 years of practical accounting experience.

- CA Intermediate/IPCC qualified or appeared; CA dropouts are welcome.

- Strong knowledge of Indian accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping.

- Hands-on experience in GST compliance, return preparation, and input tax credit reconciliation.

- Practical knowledge of TDS, statutory compliance, and Indian taxation.

- Proven experience in preparing final accounts, including Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Account, and Balance Sheet.

- Experience in e-commerce or marketplace accounting and reconciliation will be preferred.

title: Associate Director - Master Scheduling
description:
Associate Director – Master Scheduling
  
Milacron India
  
ROLE SNAPSHOT
  
Function Master Scheduling – Material & Production Planning, Logistics & SIOP
  
Reports To Sr. Director of Operations / Manufacturing
  
Direct Reports SIOP │ Material Planning │ Production Planning & Control │ Logistics (Inbound/Outbound, Import/Export) │ Stores (RM/FG).
  
Location Ahmedabad
  
Role Type Full-time, Senior Leadership
  
  
ROLE PURPOSE
  
The Master Scheduling function leads the integrated planning and scheduling backbone of the Injection Molding Machine manufacturing business. This role ensures synchronization across Material Planning, Production Planning & Control, Inbound/Outbound Logistics, Stores, and SIOP, driving operational efficiency, cost optimization, and customer delivery performance.
  
The position institutionalizes demand-supply balancing, ERP/MRP discipline, and logistics governance, converting business forecasts into executable production schedules and supply chain flows across geographies. The function serves as a primary point of contact for and liaison with sales, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Strategic Leadership and Policy
  

* Design standard operating procedures, best practices, and frameworks for the entire scheduling department.
* Align long-term operational goals with business objectives and financial targets.
* Lead, mentors, and evaluate a team of schedulers, planners, and coordinators.

Master Production Schedule (MPS) Oversight
  

* Directs the creation and maintenance of the high-level Master Production Schedule (MPS) over medium-to-long-range horizons.
* Balance demand and capacity. Evaluate the sales forecasts against facility, labour, and machine capacity to ensure realistic output.
* Risk management: Identify supply chain bottlenecks or resource shortages and run what-if scenarios to resolve conflicts

Material Planning
  

* Own material requirement planning aligned with production schedules.
* Implement and operate lean practices like VMI, JIT, ROP and Kanban to maintain optimal stock.
* Ensure timely procurement and availability of raw materials, components, and consumables. Provide rolling forecast to suppliers.
* Collaborate with supply chain team for import/export compliance and lead-time optimization.
* Decide and update safety stocks, Long lead time parts and Inventory control.

Production Planning & Control
  

* Develop master production schedules balancing demand, capacity, and inventory.
* Collaborate with design engineering, & supply chain team for ensuring sales delivery timeline.
* Monitor shop floor execution, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure adherence to timelines.
* Implement lean practices to minimize WIP and optimize throughput.

SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning)
  

* Lead monthly SIOP reviews aligning demand forecast, production capacity, and inventory targets.
* Partner with Sales, Manufacturing, Supply chain and Finance to balance customer commitments with operational realities.
* Provide executive dashboards and scenario planning for leadership decision-making.

Inbound & Outbound Logistics
  

* Manage inbound logistics for raw materials and components, including import coordination.
* Oversee outbound logistics for finished goods, ensuring timely dispatch and export documentation.
* Negotiate with logistics partners to optimize cost and service levels.

Stores Management
  

* Drive transformation projects of stores activities i.e. Receipts, Location management, Warehousing and Material movement etc.
* Oversee RM, FG, and consumables stores with robust inventory control.
* Implement digital systems for traceability, cycle counting, and stock accuracy.
* Drive safety and compliance in warehouse operations.

Team Leadership & Capability Building
  

* Lead and develop a team of professionals across planning, scheduling, logistics, and stores.
* Build capability through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

PROPOSED TEAM STRUCTURE
  
The Master Scheduling Head oversees the following direct reports and supporting desks:
  
Direct Report Key Focus Team Under
  
Production Planning & Control Build and monitor master schedules; ensure shop floor adherence and optimize throughput. PPC Engineers
  
Material Planning Align material availability with production needs; ensure timely procurement and supplier coordination. Planners & Coordination team
  
SIOP Balance demand, supply, and inventory through monthly reviews; drive forecast accuracy and executive alignment. SIOP Analysts
  
Store - RM + Inbound Logistics
  
Manage receipt, inspection, and storage of raw materials; streamline inbound logistics, operate milk runs, and compliance.
  
  
Store Team & Import / Logistics Executives
  
  
Store - Outbound Logistics (for FG & TP) Ensure timely outbound logistics and export documentation. Export / Logistics Executives
  
  
SUCCESS METRICS / KPIs
  
Planning & Control SIOP & Governance Logistics & Stores
  
On-Time Delivery (OTD)
  
Production schedule adherence
  
WIP reduction
  
ERP Master Data accuracy
  
  
Forecast accuracy (%)
  
Inventory turns
  
SIOP milestone closure (%)
  
Executive dashboard timeliness
  
  
Logistics cost optimization
  
Inventory accuracy ( >95%)
  
Import/export compliance
  
Safety & compliance metrics
  
  
KEY SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  
Skill Dimension What We Are Looking For
  
Technical & Operational Master scheduling expertise │ ERP/MRP systems │ Import/export regulations │ Logistics optimization
  
Analytics & Planning Demand-supply balancing │ Capacity planning │ Inventory modelling │ KPI dashboards │ Advanced Excel / Power BI proficiency
  
Interpersonal & Leadership
  
Cross-functional leadership │ Stakeholder management │ Team development │ Collaboration across Sales, Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Finance
  
  
Behavioral Process-driven │ Execution-focused │ Strong ownership mindset │ Decisive │ Continuous improvement orientation
  
  
EXPERIENCE PROFILE
  

* 15+ years of total experience, with 10-12 years’ experience in developing and maintaining a Master Production Schedule within a manufacturing environment, preferably in capital equipment or machine industry.
* Hands-on expertise in production planning, logistics, and SIOP.
* ERP/MRP system proficiency (JD Edwards, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Proven track record of leading large teams and delivering operational excellence.

EDUCATION
  

* Graduate/Postgraduate in Engineering (Mechanical / Production / Plastics preferred)
* Master’s in Business Administration (MBA) strongly preferred

About Avyanco

Avyanco Business Consultancy is a Dubai-based corporate advisory and business consulting firm specializing in company formation, business setup, corporate services, accounting, auditing, taxation, and regulatory compliance.

We assist entrepreneurs, investors, startups, and international businesses in establishing and expanding their operations across the UAE and other international jurisdictions.

As part of our international expansion, we are hiring ambitious, confident, and sales-driven professionals for our Ahmedabad office to support our Dubai operations and international client base.

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and results-oriented Business Setup Consultant & Sales Advisor who can handle a combination of telesales, lead generation, client consultation, business advisory, and company formation sales.

The selected candidate will be responsible for communicating with prospective clients, understanding their business requirements, recommending suitable company formation solutions, preparing proposals, following up with leads, and converting enquiries into successful business transactions.

This position combines the responsibilities of a Sales Consultant, Business Advisor, Telecaller, and Company Formation Specialist.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

. **Telesales & Lead Management**

\* Handle inbound enquiries received through websites, Google Ads, social media, WhatsApp, email, and other marketing channels.

\* Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients, entrepreneurs, investors, and business owners.

\* Qualify leads by understanding client requirements, investment budgets, business activities, and company formation objectives.

\* Maintain regular follow-ups through phone calls, WhatsApp, emails, and online meetings.

\* Reconnect with previous enquiries and identify new business opportunities.

\* Maintain accurate lead records, communication history, and sales activities in Zoho CRM.

2**. Business Setup Consultation & Advisory**

\* Advise clients on establishing businesses in Dubai and across the UAE.

\* Explain the differences between Mainland, Free Zone, and Offshore company formation.

\* Recommend appropriate business structures, licensing options, business activities, and jurisdictions based on client requirements.

\* Provide preliminary guidance on company registration, investor visas, residency, office facilities, and corporate bank account opening.

\* Explain the documentation requirements, estimated government fees, timelines, and incorporation procedures.

\* Coordinate with senior consultants in Dubai for complex company structures and specialized regulatory matters.

**3. Sales, Proposals & Revenue Generation**

\* Convert qualified enquiries into paying customers.

\* Prepare professional quotations, proposals, and company formation packages.

\* Conduct online consultations and sales presentations through Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

\* Negotiate commercial proposals within approved company pricing policies.

\* Follow up on outstanding quotations and pending client decisions.

\* Achieve individual monthly sales, conversion, and revenue targets.

\* Identify opportunities to cross-sell and upsell additional corporate services.

4. **Company Formation & Corporate Services Knowledge**

Develop strong product knowledge of Avyanco’s services, including:

\* UAE Mainland company formation

\* Dubai and UAE Free Zone company setup

\* Offshore company incorporation

\* Investor visas and Golden Visa assistance

\* Corporate bank account opening assistance

\* Trade license renewal and amendments

\* Corporate PRO and government liaison services

\* Corporate Tax and VAT registration

\* Accounting, bookkeeping, and auditing services

\* Corporate compliance and regulatory advisory

\* International company formation, including Singapore, Hong Kong, BVI, and Mauritius

**5. CRM Management & Sales Reporting**

\* Update Zoho CRM daily with accurate lead status, follow-up activities, quotations, and deal information.

\* Maintain a structured sales pipeline.

\* Submit daily call reports, lead conversion reports, and sales performance updates.

\* Coordinate with the Dubai sales and operations teams for client onboarding and service delivery.

\* Ensure professional communication and timely responses to all client enquiries.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Education**

\* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Marketing, or a related discipline.

\* MBA or relevant professional qualifications will be an advantage.

**Experience**

\* 1–5 years of experience in telesales, inside sales, business development, consultancy, banking, financial services, or corporate services.

\* Previous experience in UAE company formation, business setup consultancy, or international sales will be highly preferred.

\* Candidates from BPO, international voice processes, banking sales, insurance, and financial advisory backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

**Essential Skills**

\* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

\* Strong sales negotiation, persuasion, and closing abilities.

\* Confidence in handling international clients over telephone and video calls.

\* Ability to understand client requirements and recommend suitable solutions.

\* Professional telephone etiquette and customer relationship management.

\* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, email communication, and CRM systems.

\* Strong follow-up discipline, self-motivation, and target-oriented approach.

\* Knowledge of Hindi and Gujarati will be an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on the following indicative targets:

Performance Area Expected Target

Daily outbound and follow-up calls Minimum 30 meaningful calls

Client consultations 3 qualified consultations per day

Lead follow-up 100% within defined timelines

CRM updates Daily, with complete accuracy

Proposals and quotations As per qualified opportunities

Monthly revenue As per assigned sales target

Sales conversion Based on lead quality and agreed targets

Client satisfaction Professional and timely service

Final KPIs will be communicated based on the candidate’s experience, role level, and assigned market.

**What We Offer**

\* Opportunity to work with an established Dubai-based business consultancy.

\* Exposure to international business formation and corporate advisory services.

\* Fixed monthly salary with performance-based sales incentives.

\* Professional training on UAE business setup, licensing, visas, and corporate services.

\* Access to international leads and structured sales support.

\* Career progression into Senior Business Consultant, Team Leader, and Sales Manager positions.

\* Opportunity to work closely with Avyanco’s Dubai-based management and advisory teams.

Ideal Candidate

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

\* Enjoy speaking with clients and converting enquiries into sales.

\* Have a consultative selling approach rather than simply reading telesales scripts.

\* Are eager to develop expertise in UAE and international company formation.

\* Can independently manage leads from initial enquiry to successful closure.

\* Are ambitious, commercially minded, and motivated by sales incentives.

\* Can communicate professionally with business owners, entrepreneurs, and international investors.

Important: Prior UAE company formation experience is an advantage but not mandatory. Candidates with strong English communication, sales aptitude, and willingness to learn will receive structured training.

For our Client who is an international travel company serving customers across the UK, USA and Canada. They specialise in tailor-made holidays, accommodation, transfers and travel experiences.

We are looking for a responsible, customer-focused and well-organised **Travel Assistance & Booking Support Executive** to join our team in Ahmedabad.

The role involves looking after customers after their holiday booking is confirmed, providing assistance before departure, supporting them throughout their trip and following up after they return home.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of customer bookings and ensures every traveller receives professional, timely and reliable support.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Post-Booking Travel Management**

* Manage customer bookings from confirmation until the customer returns from their holiday.
* Send booking confirmations, hotel vouchers, travel itineraries, transfer details and other essential documents.
* Contact customers before departure to ensure they have all the necessary travel information.
* Check that hotel reservations, airport transfers and other booked services are confirmed and properly documented.
* Keep customers updated on their travel arrangements and any changes.

**2. International Customer Assistance**

* Communicate with customers from the UK, USA and Canada via email, telephone and WhatsApp.
* Respond promptly to customer queries and requests.
* Assist customers with hotel check-in issues, transfer arrangements, itinerary queries and other travel-related concerns.
* Provide timely updates and reassurance to customers during their holidays.
* Maintain professional communication and a positive customer experience at all times.

**3. Travel Issue Resolution**

* Coordinate with hotels, transfer providers, tour operators and other travel suppliers.
* Assist customers with delays, missed transfers, booking discrepancies and service-related problems.
* Follow up with suppliers to resolve issues as quickly as possible.
* Escalate urgent or complex situations to the operations team or management.
* Monitor open cases until an appropriate resolution or update has been provided.

**4. Administration & Booking Documentation**

* Maintain accurate booking records and customer information.
* Update internal systems, CRM platforms and tracking sheets.
* Ensure travel documents and vouchers are issued correctly and on time.
* Maintain records of customer communications, supplier confirmations and complaints.
* Coordinate with internal sales, operations and administration teams.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Follow-Up**

* Proactively check on customers before and during their holidays when appropriate.
* Ensure customers feel supported throughout their travel experience.
* Follow up after customers return to collect feedback.
* Identify opportunities to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Help encourage repeat business through excellent customer service.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Good administrative and organisational abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple bookings and tasks simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Professional email writing and telephone etiquette.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Google Sheets and email.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp and online booking systems.
* Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with customer complaints.
* Willingness to work either the morning or night shift, as assigned.

Preferred Experience

* Previous experience in a travel agency, tour operator, hotel, hospitality or customer support role.
* Experience handling international customers, particularly from the UK, USA or Canada.
* Familiarity with hotel bookings, transfers, travel itineraries and holiday packages.
* Experience coordinating with suppliers and resolving customer issues.
* Knowledge of CRM or travel reservation systems will be an advantage.

Candidates with strong communication skills and relevant customer service or administrative experience are also welcome to apply.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

description:
**Job Title:** Interior Estimator & Quotation Executive  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Preferred)  
**Job Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment type:** Full time

**Job Summary**

The Interior Estimator & Quotation Executive is responsible for preparing accurate, detailed, Excel-based quotations for modular furniture and interior projects using AutoCAD drawings, design layouts, project specifications, and material requirements. The role involves calculating material quantities, hardware, accessories, labour costs, and overall project pricing while coordinating with the design, production, purchase, and sales teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drawing Analysis: Study AutoCAD 2D drawings, furniture layouts, elevations, sections, and detailed designs to understand project requirements.
* Quantity Estimation: Calculate quantities of boards, laminates, plywood, MDF, aluminium profiles, glass, hardware, fittings, and other materials.
* Quotation Preparation: Prepare detailed quotations using MS Excel based on approved drawings, material specifications, and company pricing standards.
* Cost Calculation: Estimate material costs, hardware costs, labour charges, installation expenses, transportation, and other applicable project costs.
* Rate Analysis: Maintain updated material rates, vendor price lists, hardware prices, and costing databases.
* Design Coordination: Coordinate with designers to clarify drawing dimensions, specifications, and missing project details.
* Production Coordination: Verify material requirements and quantities with the production team to ensure practical and accurate costing.
* Vendor Coordination: Obtain prices from suppliers and vendors and compare rates to support cost-effective purchasing.
* Quotation Revision: Update quotations according to changes in drawings, materials, specifications, or client requirements.
* Documentation: Maintain organized records of drawings, BOQs (Bills of Quantities), quotations, costing sheets, and revisions.
* Order Finalization: Assist the sales and management teams with final costing, quotation submissions, and order-related documentation.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate or diploma holder in Interior Design, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field; relevant experience may also be considered.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, lookup functions, data handling, and quotation formats.
* Basic to good knowledge of AutoCAD 2D for reading and interpreting technical drawings.
* Understanding of modular furniture, wardrobes, kitchens, TV units, office furniture, and interior fit-out projects.
* Knowledge of materials such as plywood, MDF, particle board, laminates, veneers, aluminium profiles, and hardware fittings.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and costing skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in calculations.
* Good coordination, communication, and time-management skills.

**Experience**

* Preferred: 1–3 years of experience in interior estimation, modular furniture costing, BOQ preparation, or quotation management.
* Freshers with strong Excel skills and a good understanding of interior drawings may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of material quantity calculations and quotations.
* Timely preparation and submission of quotations.
* Reduction in costing errors and material wastage.
* Proper maintenance of quotation and pricing records.
* Effective coordination with design, production, purchase, and sales teams.
* Timely revision of quotations following design changes.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: Admissions & Onboarding Executive
description:
**Job Title:** Admissions & Onboarding Executive

**Company:** AI Product Leadership Studio - An Initiative By Hyumeans Pvt Ltd

**Location:** Work from home, with occasional meetings in Ahmedabad. Candidates should be based in Ahmedabad or nearby.

**Job Type:** Full-time, with a 3-month probation

**Working hours:** 8 Hours Flexible, Tuesday to Sunday.

**Reports to:** Founder

**Pay:** ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 per month fixed, plus incentive on enrolments and other bonuses (details below)

**About us**

AI Product Leadership Studio is a live program for working product professionals who want to grow into product leaders. It runs for 5 weeks. Participants take real leadership decisions in a business simulation, and then spend up to 30 days getting exposure to a real company.

Our applicants are experienced and busy professionals. They do not like being chased or pressured. We handle admissions the way a premium university does: we choose people carefully, and we are honest when the program is not right for someone.

**About the role**

You will be the first person an applicant speaks to, and the person a participant depends on from payment until Day 1 and after. You will work directly with the founder, so your work is seen and your suggestions are used. This is a small team and you will not have a manager checking on you all day, but you will have a short daily check-in with the founder.

**What you will own**

*1. Every serious applicant gets a fast and honest answer*

* Reply to new enquiries within 15 minutes between 10 am and 7 pm. Outside these hours, reply within 1 hour.
* Have a short first conversation and check fit using our fit checklist (current role, experience, why now, ability to attend). If someone does not fit, tell them politely and suggest a better option for them.
* Book fit applicants on the founder’s calendar, send reminders, and share a short brief before the call.

*2. Every person who says yes actually joins*

* After the founder’s call, follow up for payment within 72 hours. Maximum 3 follow-ups per person.
* Onboard each paid participant: forms, welcome message, schedule, platform access and pre-reading.
* Make sure every participant is ready and present on Day 1.

*3. Nothing goes wrong quietly*

* Reply to every complaint or feedback within 4 hours, log it, and pass it to the founder within 24 hours. Refund and exception decisions are always taken by the founder.
* Send a short daily report.

*Also part of the role (about 3 to 4 hours a week)*

* Manage the founder’s meeting schedule and clashes.

**What success looks like in your first 90 days**

* You reply to at least 90% of enquiries within 15 minutes in working hours.
* At least 80% of booked calls actually happen.
* Every paid participant is fully onboarded before Day 1.
* Every complaint is logged and passed on within 24 hours.
* Your weekly report reaches us on time, every week.

**What we are looking for**

* 1 to 3 years in admissions, a program office, inside sales, customer success or premium client service. A fresher with excellent communication can also apply.
* Very good written and spoken English and Hindi. Most of your work is on WhatsApp and email, and our applicants notice small mistakes.
* Comfortable speaking English and Hindi.
* Calm, polite and well organised. You can handle many things at once without dropping any.
* Comfortable with a CRM, Google Sheets, Google Calendar and MS-Office.
* Your own laptop and stable internet.
* Able to join immediately.

*Good to have:* experience with senior or working-professional clients, executive education or university admissions, and some interest in product management or technology.

**How you will be paid**

* Fixed monthly salary.
* Incentive on every enrolment, calculated on the fee actually received and paid after the refund period ends.
* A bonus for every participant who stays enrolled.
* A bonus for each batch with good show-up rates and quick complaint handling.
* An annual retention bonus after 12 months.

Incentive depends on the number of enrolments, so your total pay will change from month to month. The full incentive policy is shared in writing at the interview stage.

**What you get**

* Direct learning from the founder, who works in product leadership at a global technology company.
* Ownership of a real function, not a small piece of one.
* A path to Admissions & Onboarding Lead after 6 to 12 months of good work.
* Free access to the program after 6 months of good work.

**Hiring process**

* Written answer with your application.
* A short role-play call with the founder.
* A short practical test.
* Reference check.
* A paid 2 to 3 day trial.

We decide within 7 days of each stage.

**How to apply**

Send your resume along with a reply, in under 100 words, to this question:

*“A working professional asks you on WhatsApp: How is this program different from other product courses, and why is it priced at ₹50,000?”*

Applications without this answer will not be considered.

Hyumeans Pvt Ltd is an equal opportunity employer.

* Research international market trends, competitor pricing, customer preferences, and emerging business opportunities.

* Strong understanding of international B2B sales, export procedures, shipping documentation, and Incoterms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, and CRM or sales tracking tools.
* Good written and spoken English; knowledge of additional foreign languages will be an advantage.
* Willingness to work with international clients across different time zones and travel for exhibitions or client meetings when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly and annual export sales revenue.
* Number of new international buyers acquired.
* Number of qualified leads and conversion rate.
* Number and value of export orders secured.
* Repeat business and client retention.
* Timely order execution and payment collection.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in international sales of babywear, kidswear, ethnic wear, garments, textiles, or fashion products will be preferred. Experience in developing overseas distributor networks and handling end-to-end export sales will be an added advantage.

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-Site)

**Shift Timings:** U.S. Eastern Time, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About Dash Technologies**
---------------------------

Dash Technologies Inc., headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, is a rapidly expanding IT services and staffing organization known for delivering high-quality talent solutions across enterprise and government clients in the United States. We specialize in compliance-driven hiring, VMS/MSP and Direct Client environments, and government-specific requirements, and we partner with over two dozen U.S. state government agencies on critical technology initiatives — including strategic programs such as AI strategy development and implementation.

As we continue to scale our U.S. public sector practice, we are strengthening the leadership of our Business Development team with a professional who understands the nuances of selling into American state and local government agencies and can lead others to do the same.

**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking a seasoned Business Development Manager to drive Dash Technologies' continued growth in the U.S. SLED staffing space. This is a dual role: you will lead and drive a team of Business Development Executives (BDEs) while remaining a hands-on individual contributor with your own revenue targets. Our territory is organized by state: each BDE is assigned a set of U.S. states, and you will hold your own individual states in the same way.

The ideal candidate brings more than 8 years of experience, deep familiarity with American state and local government agency environments, exceptional American English communication skills, and sharp analytical capabilities. You will own the full business development cycle — from market research and lead generation to decision-maker engagement, relationship management, and strategic account expansion — for your own accounts, and you will be accountable for how your team executes that same cycle across U.S. State, Local and Education clients.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and drive a team of Business Development Executives, each responsible for an assigned set of U.S. states, against their lead generation, outreach, meeting, and revenue targets.
* Set weekly and monthly activity plans for the team, run daily huddles and pipeline reviews, and hold each BDE accountable for disciplined follow-up.
* Review outreach quality, join calls with agency IT decisionmakers, and build each BDE's capability in U.S. state and local government selling.
* Report team and individual performance to leadership, including outreach activity, decision-maker meetings, pipeline, and revenue.

**Individual Contribution**

* Assume full responsibility for business development and revenue generation across an assigned territory of U.S. states. Within those states, generate new leads; identify and directly engage key agency decisionmakers, including CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, and IT Managers; assess business opportunities; and qualify deals aligned with Dash Technologies' growth strategy.

  

* Acquire and develop trusted, long-term relationships with a portfolio of clients in your assigned states, with a primary focus on State, Local & Education government agencies.
* Expand business with existing customers through consistent engagement, deep understanding of client needs, and proactive identification of growth opportunities across their programs.
* Build and sustain direct relationships with agency IT decision-makers through calls, email, LinkedIn, and meetings, so that Dash is known to them before a requirement is released.

**Strategy and Market Development**

* Design and execute comprehensive outbound sales and business development strategies, including structured sales processes, pipeline management, and adoption of industry best practices.
* Conduct and direct in-depth market research using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, and other modern AI-powered prospecting tools to track market trends, identify demand signals, and uncover new business opportunities in the U.S. public sector.
* Identify new statewide IT staffing contracts, cooperative vehicles, and local government accounts, and guide the registrations and enrollments needed to sell there.
* Maintain a competitive, market-aware mindset to continuously identify new business avenues that contribute to Dash Technologies' revenue, profitability, and project growth.
* Develop and execute effective sales, marketing, and business development plans, including market database acquisition, segmentation, and CRM integration.
* Consistently meet sales objectives, including project volume, revenue, and profitability targets, for yourself and your team.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

* **More than 8 years of Business Development / Sales experience** in a service industry — preferably U.S. IT Consulting or Staffing.
* **Proven experience leading a business development team** while carrying individual targets.
* **Strong familiarity with U.S. state and local government agency environments** — including an understanding of procurement cycles, RFP/RFI processes, VMS/MSP platforms (Fieldglass, Dotstaff, etc.), and prime/subcontractor relationships.
* **Excellent American English communication & comprehension** — both written and verbal — with the ability to engage confidently with U.S. government stakeholders and enterprise decision-makers.
* **Strong analytical skills** — able to interpret market data, evaluate opportunities, read and qualify RFPs, and translate insights into actionable business development strategies.
* A demonstrable record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Resourceful and proactive, with a willingness to conduct deep research on clients, prospects, and individual contacts.
* Presentable and professional demeanor suitable for representing Dash Technologies to senior U.S. clients.
* Self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to coach and motivate others.
* Hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, CRM tools, and emerging AI-based prospecting platforms.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Prior experience selling staffing or IT services into U.S. State & Local government agencies.
* Existing relationships with IT leadership in U.S. state and local government agencies.
* Exposure to compliance frameworks relevant to government staffing (E-Verify, I-9, state-specific clearances, MBE/WBE certifications).
* Experience working with U.S. Tier-1 System Integrators as a prime/sub partner on state engagements.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity to shape and scale a high-growth U.S. public sector practice at a fast-moving, Dublin, Ohio–headquartered IT services firm.
* Leadership of a Business Development team alongside direct ownership of your own assigned states and a meaningful book of U.S. State & Local government clients.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with strong leadership support and clear career progression.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience and performance.

* Follow up with internal teams to ensure timely closure of assigned tasks.
* Prepare MOMs, trackers, reports, presentations and management updates.

* Coordinate with vendors, consultants and service providers.
* Maintain company documents, agreements, records and correspondence.
* Coordinate travel, meetings, visits and other management requirements as required.
* Follow up on procurement and administrative requirements and pending approvals.

* Ensure administrative tasks are completed within defined timelines.

4\. Compliance \& Documentation

* Maintain a compliance calendar and tracker for recurring company requirements.

* Track renewal/validity of registrations, certificates, licences and company documentation.

5\. HR \& Recruitment Support

* Assist with onboarding documentation and employee records.

* Follow up with responsible employees for project actions and deadlines.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**What you will be selling**

This is a SaaS sale, not a product or commodity sale. You are selling a subscription\-based software platform to business owners who are used to doing things manually. You must be comfortable selling technology, running a live demo, and explaining a system, not just quoting a price.

Our company is a recurring\-revenue software platform with a web app and mobile app. Your prospects are pharmacy owners, district managers, and head\-office operations leaders, most of whom are not technical. Your job is to make a software solution sound simple, obvious, and worth switching to. If you have sold SaaS, IT services, or any technology product before, this will feel familiar. If you have only ever sold physical goods, this role will be a hard jump.

**The role — read this part carefully**

This is a phone\-first role. The majority of your day will be spent on the phone, cold calling pharmacy owners, managers, and decision\-makers across Canada. If you are not comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day, please do not apply.

You will own the full sales cycle — building your own call list, making the calls, handling objections on the spot, running the software demo, following up relentlessly, and closing the subscription. You will be the first voice a Canadian pharmacy hears from our company, so your English, your tone, and your ability to think on your feet directly determine whether we win that account or lose it.

This is not a role for someone who needs hand\-holding. We want someone who is self\-motivated, thinks creatively, takes initiative, and brings energy to the work every day.

**What you will do**

* Make a high volume of cold calls every day to pharmacy owners, managers, and head\-office decision\-makers across Canada. This is the core of the job, not a side task.
* Handle objections live on the call — price, timing, "we already have an agency", "we don't want another app", "send me an email", "not interested". You need answers ready and the confidence to keep the conversation going.
* Run online product demos over Zoom or Teams — walk a prospect through the platform, answer functional and basic technical questions, and connect features to the problems that pharmacies are actually facing.
* Learn the product deeply — you are expected to know the platform well enough to answer most questions yourself without escalating to the technical team.
* Own the end\-to\-end sales process — prospecting, calling, qualification, demo, negotiation, onboarding paperwork, and closing.
* Follow up by email, WhatsApp, and phone until you get a clear yes or a clear no. Deals are lost on follow\-up, not on the first call.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline in the CRM; keep call notes, statuses, and next steps accurate and up to date every day.
* Report your own numbers — calls made, connects, demos booked, and deals closed — without being chased for them.
* Feed real market objections and feature requests back to the product team so the platform keeps improving.
* Collaborate with the Client Success team to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding of new clients after signing.

**What we are looking for**

**Non\-negotiable requirements — please only apply if all of these apply to you.**

**SaaS or IT product and services sales experience — minimum 2 years actively selling software, subscriptions, platforms, apps, or IT services. Not lead generation for a software company; actual selling. Tell us what you sold, who you sold it to, and what the subscription or contract value was.**

**Ability to demo software confidently — you can run a screen\-share walkthrough of a platform, explain how it works to a non\-technical business owner, and handle questions such as "how does it integrate", "is our data safe", and "what if my staff can't use it" without freezing.**

**Comfort with technology — CRM, dialer, Zoom or Teams, shared docs, WhatsApp Business. You should be the kind of person who figures out a new tool on their own rather than waiting for training.**

**Excellent spoken English — clear pronunciation, neutral accent, and confident delivery. You will be on live calls with Canadian pharmacy owners and executives throughout the day. Weak or hesitant English will not work in this role, no exceptions.**

**Strong objection\-handling skills — you can stay calm when someone says no, ask the right question back, and turn a cold response into a conversation.**

**Proven cold calling experience — you have done outbound calling as a daily habit, not occasionally, and you can tell us your typical daily call volume.**

**Honesty and integrity — you report your numbers accurately, tell us when something did not get done, and never overstate a lead's interest to look good on a report.**

**Accountability and ownership — you own your targets and your results. When something goes wrong, you come with the problem and a plan, not an excuse.**

**Responsiveness is mandatory — you reply to emails, WhatsApp messages, texts, and calls from clients and from the team promptly during working hours. If you are someone who leaves messages unread and calls unreturned, this role is not for you.**

**Work ethic — this is a demanding, target\-driven role with real earning upside for people who put in the effort. If you are looking for an easy desk job where you can coast, please do not apply.**

**Onsite availability — this role is based at our office in Sargasan, Gandhinagar. Remote work is not available for this position.**

**Scheduling flexibility — our clients are in Canada. Calls and meetings will need to be scheduled in alignment with Canadian time zones, including Eastern and Pacific time zones. You must be genuinely flexible with your working hours on those days.**

**Punctuality and reliability — missed follow\-ups and late responses cost us deals. You must be disciplined, organised, and on time — always.**

**Strongly preferred**

Healthcare, staffing, HR tech, or marketplace SaaS experience — selling workforce, scheduling, HRMS, or ERP software is the closest match to what we do.

Experience with subscription and recurring\-revenue selling — you understand that the sale is not finished at signup and that renewals depend on how you set expectations up front.

Experience selling SaaS or IT services into North American markets — Canada or the US.

Hands\-on experience with CRM and sales technology — HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator (MUST), or similar.

Understanding of basic SaaS sales metrics — pipeline stages, conversion rates, MRR, and churn.

**Compensation**

**Base Salary:** Competitive fixed monthly salary.

**Commission:** Performance\-based commission with uncapped earning potential.

**Monthly Targets**

Your base salary covers your fixed monthly income. On top of that, you earn commission on every deal you close — the more you sell, the more you earn. There is no cap on what you can make. Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

**Why join our company**

* Sell a real technology product that is solving a genuine problem for healthcare businesses across Canada.
* Build international SaaS sales experience and exposure to Canadian market dynamics — without leaving Ahmedabad.
* Work in a small team where your contribution has high visibility and your impact is tangible from day one.
* Have a direct line to the product team — what you hear on calls can actually shape the product roadmap.
* Be part of a culture that values ownership, outcomes, and honesty over processes and hierarchy.
* Have real earning potential through a commission structure that rewards results, not just effort.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

title: US Sales Executive – B2B Cold Calling
description:
**Company:** SwiftSku  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Model:** 5 Days Work from Office  
**Shift:** US Shift \| 6:30 PM–3:30 AM IST  
**Experience:** 2\+ years in US/International Sales  
**Languages:** Fluent English and Gujarati; Hindi preferred

About SwiftSku

SwiftSku is a Y Combinator\-backed technology startup helping family\-owned convenience stores across the United States grow and operate more efficiently.

Our Point of Sale ecosystem and mobile technology simplify store operations and help business owners make better decisions. We are building an ambitious Ahmedabad\-based team that works directly with American customers.

About the Role

We are hiring a confident and results\-driven US Sales Executive with hands\-on experience in outbound cold calling.

This is an individual\-contributor role for candidates who are comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls, speaking with US\-based prospects, handling objections and independently moving opportunities towards closure.

This is not a field sales, retail sales or domestic sales position.

Key Responsibilities

* Make high\-volume outbound cold calls to US\-based business prospects.
* Generate qualified leads and build a strong sales pipeline.
* Identify customer needs and present relevant SwiftSku solutions.
* Communicate confidently with business owners and decision\-makers in the United States.
* Handle objections using active listening and value\-based responses.
* Schedule product demonstrations and follow up consistently with prospects.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, negotiation and closure.
* Maintain accurate call notes, follow\-up activities and pipeline updates in the CRM.
* Achieve daily calling, meeting and revenue targets.
* Collaborate with the Sales, Account Management and Leadership teams.

Required Experience and Skills

* Minimum 2 years of consistent outbound cold\-calling experience.
* Proven experience selling to customers in the United States or other international markets.
* Experience managing a high daily volume of outbound calls.
* Strong understanding of US buyer communication, tone, pacing and professional etiquette.
* Experience in B2B, SaaS, software, IT services, technology or solution sales is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to generate leads, handle objections and close deals independently.
* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
* Gujarati\-speaking ability is mandatory.
* Comfortable working permanently in the US night shift.
* Comfortable working five days a week from the Ahmedabad office.
* Strong ownership, resilience, target orientation and follow\-up discipline.
* Familiarity with CRM and sales prospecting tools is preferred.

Who Should Apply?

Apply if you have experience in any of the following areas:

* US Sales
* International Sales
* US Outbound Calling
* B2B Cold Calling
* Inside Sales
* SaaS or Software Sales
* International Business Development
* Lead Generation for the US Market
* Account Management with upselling or revenue responsibilities

Who Should Not Apply?

This position may not be suitable if your experience is limited to:

* Domestic or field sales
* Retail, insurance, real estate, pharmaceutical or FMCG sales
* Customer support without sales targets
* Inbound calling without outbound prospecting
* Team management without recent individual cold\-calling experience
* Candidates seeking remote, hybrid or day\-shift opportunities

Why Join SwiftSku?

* Work directly with American businesses and customers.
* Build your career in a fast\-growing, Y Combinator\-backed startup.
* Receive continuous coaching and opportunities for merit\-based growth.
* Take ownership of meaningful sales outcomes.
* Join an ambitious and collaborative team.

Application Requirement

Please apply only if you are comfortable with:

* Full\-time, work\-from\-office employment in Ahmedabad
* US night\-shift working hours
* High\-volume outbound cold calling
* Individual sales targets
* Communicating fluently in English and Gujarati

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹135,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment

* Paid time off
